sql: SELECT c.customer_sk, m.merchant_sk FROM dim_customer AS c JOIN v_payment_intent AS p ON c.customer_sk = p.customer_sk JOIN dim_merchant AS m ON p.merchant_sk = m.merchant_sk LIMIT 100
